create_ListDataset_with_files: create a ListDataset from a list of image file paths using the default image loader
create_ListDataset_with_metadata: create a ListDataset with image files and a list of target labels as metadata
create_ListDataset_with_custom_loader: create a ListDataset using a custom loader function instead of the default image loader
getitem_ListDataset: get a sample from the ListDataset by index returning input and metadata as a dict
len_ListDataset: get the total number of items in the ListDataset by calling len on the dataset
